_comment: Copy-ready template for _shared/target-profile.json. Written once per audit run by stack-fingerprint-wasp-drone (wave W1a) and read read-only by every later Drone, per the PRD-003 shared-workspace contract. Produced by shared/scripts/fingerprint.py's build_profile(); this file documents the shape for a human author and for any Drone that needs to hand-write or validate one. Replace every <angle-bracket> placeholder; delete this _comment key before writing the real file, JSON has no native comment syntax.
reachable: <true | false. If false, every field below except target_url/generated_at/reachable is meaningless, stop and report the fetch failure instead of guessing>
stack: <one of: react-vite-postgres | nextjs-postgres | sveltekit-postgres | wordpress-php-mysql | shopify | magento-php-mysql | unknown. Never a value outside this enum, per PRD-003 goals>
platform: <human-readable label matching stack, e.g. 'WordPress', 'Next.js', 'Shopify'. 'unknown' if stack is unknown>
platform_guide: <repo-relative path to the build-plan-section-6 platform guide site-crawler-wasp-drone should load next, e.g. shared/platform-guides/platform-cms-wordpress.md. null when stack is unknown>
rendering: <one of: ssr | csr | hybrid | other | unknown-requires-headless-load. Must be derived from response body plus one real headless-browser load per PRD-003, never guessed from documentation or framework reputation>
grounded: <researched | judgment-call. Whether the winning stack signature traces to this Stinger's research archive or is an explicit judgment call per the distillation's gap note. See references/fingerprint-signature-table.md>

evidence.signal: <the exact matched string or header name>

hosting_hints: <optional CDN/hosting labels inferred from headers, e.g. 'Cloudflare', 'Vercel'. Informational only, never used to set `stack`>
other_candidates: <any other stack ids that also matched at lower confidence, for audit-trail purposes only>

raw_signals._comment: Present ONLY when stack is 'unknown'. Never force an unrecognized site into the nearest known category, per PRD-003 AC-2, non-goal 2. Attach exactly what was collected so a human can classify it later.
